provenance.registration_method: Native-resolution plan-view occupancy registration against the current 25 mm SAND/ROCK/WATER support, refined by affine ECC and cross-image SIFT constraints. Image 6 is a perspective cross-reference only.
provenance.coordinate_convention: Native screenshot pixels use top-left origin. For plan images, world_xy = offset_xy + matrix_2x2 * [u, v]. Review bboxes are [xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax] in metres.
provenance.evidence_vs_action_note: Screenshot marks and hand-drawn lines provide approximate locations, outlines, density discontinuities, and visible object identity only. They are not WATER/SAND/ROCK classifiers and no bbox or stroke is a direct fill, clipping, or deletion mask. Actions, layer assignment, ScanID=10, confidence requirements, density tapering, and reversible removal come from the written request and must be validated against measured 3D support.

yellow_review_polygon.role: Broad review zone only; never use as a blanket terrain or WATER fill mask.

cyan_southern_gap.role: Review the enclosed lower gaps. The freehand stroke self-loops, so use the bbox to locate candidates and measured support to derive actual fill components.

red_density_taper_guide.role: Approximate soft transition guide. It is neither a clipping boundary nor a prescribed fixed-width taper.

perspective_cross_reference.image_6_marks_1_and_3_to_image_1_marks_5: two-bag group correspondence; one-to-one order unresolved
perspective_cross_reference.image_6_marks_4_and_5_to_image_1_mark_8: two-person group correspondence; individual world centroids unresolved

obstruction_review.selection_rule: Bboxes locate candidate components only. Confirm complete people/bag components using connected 3D geometry plus RGB/intensity evidence; do not delete every point in an envelope.

density_continuity.sampling: deterministic variable-radius blue noise against both measured and already-selected points
density_continuity.interface_rule: Match the local measured SAND/ROCK spacing at the shoreline before any outward taper; cull individual candidates within the local exclusion radius rather than whole squares.

right_edge_taper.interpolation: bounded C1 cubic smoothstep over signed outward distance

independent_surface_predictions: robust local tangent or MLS surface
